t: Sermon 37. Law and Grace › II. Now we come to the second part of the subject, and that is THE ENTRANCE OF THE LAW INTO THE HEART.

items.e: We have to deal carefully when we come to deal with internal things; it is not easy to talk about this little thing, the heart. When we begin to meddle with the law of their soul, many become indignant, but we do not fear their wrath. We are going to attack the hidden man this morning. The law entered their hearts that sin might abound, “but where sin abounded, grace did much more abound.”
